subject: Rentals confirmed by text
body:
Hi,

Otterlight Kayaks' site says rentals are confirmed by text. The board on the dock is wiped each evening, so the morning starts from messages rather than from a list someone trusts.

A short conversation could separate which texts a guest still needs to send from which ones the dock could answer.

Worth a 15-minute chat?
